summary: Iter 231l (Trade Snooze 24h + draft_picks.py extraction) fully validated. Backend pytest: new suite test_iter231l_snooze_and_draft_picks_extraction.py 11/11 PASS (4 sync extraction guards + 7 async snooze behavior tests). Backend regression: 46 prior tests (test_iter231k_draft_queue_auction_extraction 5/5, test_iter231k_smoke 5/5, test_iter231j 9/9, test_iter231h 8/8, test_iter231g 4/4, test_iter231c 4/4, test_iter170j 7/7, test_iter170m 4/4) all PASS. Live smoke against the public preview URL as chriszarek@gmail.com: POST /api/trades/{id}/snooze returns 200 for the recipient with the expected JSON body (trade_id, snoozed_until ~24h future, hours=24); returns 403 for a non-recipient (chriszarek@live.com) with detail 'Only the trade\'s recipient can snooze it.'; GET /api/users/me/pending-trades drops the trade from awaiting_response immediately after snooze and re-includes it after the snoozed_until_by key is unset. The new draft_picks router responds to both GET and POST /api/drafts/{id}/picks/{pick_no}/defer (404/400 on bogus draft id confirm wiring). Frontend dashboard (1440x800, chriszarek@gmail.com): banner renders, desktop snooze button is opacity:0 by default and animates to opacity:1 on row hover; clicking it removes the row optimistically, fires sonner toast 'Trade snoozed for 24h — Ice Breakers ↔ Zarek\'s Frozen hidden from dashboard. Still visible in /transactions.', and the removal persists across page reload (backend wrote snoozed_until_by). Mobile (390x844): pending-trade-snooze-mobile-{tradeId} renders always-visible (opacity 1, display inline-flex, bounding box 98x26 at y=507) and the desktop variant is display:none; tap triggers the same optimistic remove + toast. Deep-link regression: clicking a banner row navigates to /transactions/trade/{tradeId} and surfaces the Accept / Reject buttons on the trade detail page. Test artifact (snooze on trade 6a3f5c2fe608b2d3645729d1) cleaned up — set snoozed_until_by back to unset so the next testing agent sees chriszarek's 1 awaiting trade.

issues: Mobile snooze button is only 26px tall (bounding box 98x26). Apple HIG recommends >=44pt and Material >=48dp for touch targets. The container row meets 48px, but the snooze button itself does not. Consider min-h-[36px]/py-2 to bump the button to a comfortable tap target without changing layout drastically.

action_items: (Minor / optional) Increase mobile Snooze button vertical padding so the touch target meets 44pt/48dp guidance; current button is 26px tall.

(Pre-existing, not iter231l) WebSocket handshake to wss://.../api/socket.io still returns 403 in the preview env — surfaces as noisy console errors but does not affect HTTP flows; out of scope for this iter.
critical_code_review_comments: drafts.py size ratchet now <2500 (asserted in test_drafts_py_size_ratchet_under_2500). draft_picks.py owns both GET + POST defer endpoints plus DeferPickChoiceRequest + _VALID_DEFER_CHOICES — clean cut, no dangling references in drafts.py.

POST /api/trades/{id}/snooze correctly clamps `hours` to [1, 168] (verified by test_snooze_hours_capped_at_one_week — 9999 → 168). 403 for proposer and 403 for non-recipient have distinct, helpful detail strings. 400 when target trade is not in 'proposed' state.

Per-user filtering uses trade.snoozed_until_by.{uid} ISO string; expired snoozes are correctly ignored (verified by test_expired_snooze_resurfaces_trade with direct-DB past-dated key). No risk of one user's snooze hiding the trade from teammates (per-user dict keyed by uid).

Optimistic UI in PendingTradesBanner.jsx (lines 129-152) properly rolls back on backend failure and shows toast.error. The toast.success description echoes both team names so users can disambiguate which trade was snoozed.

data-testid pattern is consistent: pending-trade-snooze-{tradeId} (desktop, hover-revealed via opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100) and pending-trade-snooze-mobile-{tradeId} (always-visible via sm:hidden). Click handler calls e.preventDefault + e.stopPropagation so the parent Link does not navigate.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on flows tested (desktop hover-reveal + click + persistence; mobile always-visible + tap; deep-link to trade detail)
